evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically during growth from ~3.02 to 3.48 Torr at constant Ar 100 sccm
Ar flow steady at setpoint, so rise is not a flow change
Temperature holding at 750 °C with nominal heater power; thermal control normal
O2 exhaust sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak status cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An installed exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/valve-isolation leak-up test) to distinguish a seal/air leak from partial exhaust blockage; pressure response to a step change in Ar flow.
